meta.name: Enrich Google Sheets domains with verified decision makers via Apify

name: Enrich company domains from Google Sheets with verified decision makers using Apify

parameters.content:
## Who's it for

This workflow is for sales operations, recruiting, and agency teams that keep company-domain research queues in Google Sheets and need named decision makers with reviewed business contact details.

## How it works

The workflow reads rows marked `READY` from an `Inputs` sheet, normalizes and deduplicates the domains, and builds one controlled batch. It starts Apify's Decision Maker Finder asynchronously, polls the run without retrying the non-idempotent start request, and downloads the dataset only after the run succeeds.

Every requested domain receives a classification, including domains omitted from the paid dataset because no result was delivered. Named contacts are written to `Results`. `Inputs` only stores queue status. `Run_Log` stores the audit trail. Source rows move from `READY` to `IN_PROGRESS` before the Actor starts, then receive their final classification or failure status.

## How to set up

1. Make a copy of the template spreadsheet:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CGxn1Z9Ton7rL4j2OTuN-4-vQoapsARf0r1iW8Ur5oE/copy
2. Add Google Sheets OAuth credentials in n8n and select them on every Sheets node.
3. Add an n8n Bearer Auth credential with your Apify API token (token only, no Bearer prefix) on every Apify HTTP Request node.
4. From your copy URL:
`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID/edit`
Paste `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID` into **Set workflow configuration** → `google_sheet_id`.
5. In `Inputs`, add rows such as `recivu.it | IT | READY`, then run a small test batch. Read names and emails in the `Results` tab, not in `Inputs`.

## Requirements

An n8n instance, Google Sheets access, and an Apify account are required. The Actor charges per delivered result. Set a maximum run charge and review current pricing before execution.

## How to customize

Change the target persona, batch limit, polling interval, or sheet names in one configuration node. Keep human review before outreach. Business contact data may be personal data, so apply appropriate access, retention, lawful-basis, and opt-out controls.

## 1. Configure and read the queue

Copy the public template:

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CGxn1Z9Ton7rL4j2OTuN-4-vQoapsARf0r1iW8Ur5oE/copy

Paste your spreadsheet ID into **Set workflow configuration** → `google_sheet_id`.

Use normal sheet ranges, not Google Sheets Tables.

**Inputs** = queue only

`domain | country | status | batch_id | apify_run_id | result_class | processed_at | error_message`

Example: `recivu.it | IT | READY`

**Results** = named contacts (not in Inputs)

**Run_Log** = audit on `batch_id`

Use the same Google Sheets OAuth credential on every Sheets node.

## 2. Start and monitor Apify safely

Create an n8n **Bearer Auth** credential. Do not use Header Auth.

1. Type: **Bearer Auth** / `httpBearerAuth`
2. Token: paste only `apify_api_...` (no word Bearer)
3. Select it on Start, Get status, and Get results

`token-not-provided` → credential empty or not selected on Start.

`START_UNKNOWN` → start POST failed before a run ID. Check Apify Console.

Actor-start POST has no automatic retry.

Status and dataset GETs use bounded retries. Polling has a hard limit.

## 3. Reconcile and classify every domain

Empty Actor results are omitted from the paid dataset.

This workflow still classifies every requested domain.

Missing domains get `NO_BILLABLE_RESULT`.

Other classes: `VERIFIED_DM_REVIEW`, `REVIEW_IDENTITY`, `GENERIC_EMAIL_ONLY`, `PHONE_ONLY`, `NAMED_NO_SENDABLE_EMAIL`, `INVALID_INPUT`, `DUPLICATE_IN_BATCH`.

A class does not make outreach automatically lawful. Always review.

## 4. Persist results and audit data

`Results`: one upserted row per requested domain and persona.

`Run_Log`: execution, Apify run, dataset, count, failures.

Sheets writes use safe retries.

Do not run overlapping executions on the same `READY` queue.

Keep execution retention short. Restrict access to contact data.

## Cost and failure warning

- Default batch limit: 5 domains (Apify trial-friendly)
- Default max run charge: USD 5 — review before scaling
- Never auto-retry **Start Decision Maker Finder**
- `START_UNKNOWN` = ambiguous start; check Apify Console
- Failures land in `Run_Log` before **Stop failed workflow**
- Never put credentials, spreadsheet IDs, personal emails, or customer data in the exported template

parameters.jsCode:
const prepared = $('Prepare one Actor batch').first().json;
const processedAt = $now.toISO();
return prepared.invalid_rows.map((invalid) => ({ json: {
  source_row: invalid.source_row,
  result_key: `${invalid.domain ?? `invalid-row-${invalid.source_row ?? 'unknown'}`}|${prepared.persona}`,
  batch_id: prepared.batch_id,
  apify_run_id: null,
  domain: invalid.domain,
  country: invalid.country,
  persona: prepared.persona,
  classification: invalid.classification,
  email_sendable: false,
  identity_flags: '[]',
  has_contact: false,
  processed_at: processedAt,
  error_message: invalid.error_message ?? ''
} }));

const rows = $input.all().map(({ json }) => json);
const prepared = $('Prepare one Actor batch').first().json;
const run = $('Reconcile Apify status').first().json;
const count = (classes) => rows.filter((row) => classes.includes(row.classification)).length;
return [{ json: {
  batch_id: prepared.batch_id,
  execution_id: prepared.execution_id,
  status: 'SUCCEEDED',
  started_at: prepared.started_at,
  finished_at: $now.toISO(),
  apify_run_id: run.apify_run_id,
  dataset_id: run.dataset_id,
  requested_domains: JSON.stringify(prepared.requested_domains),
  valid_domains: prepared.valid_rows.length,
  invalid_domains: prepared.invalid_rows.length,
  result_count: rows.length,
  verified_count: count(['VERIFIED_DM_REVIEW']),
  review_count: count(['REVIEW_IDENTITY', 'GENERIC_EMAIL_ONLY', 'PHONE_ONLY', 'NAMED_NO_SENDABLE_EMAIL']),
  no_result_count: count(['NO_BILLABLE_RESULT', 'INVALID_INPUT', 'DUPLICATE_IN_BATCH']),
  poll_count: run.poll_count,
  error_class: null,
  error_message: null,
  apify_run_url: run.apify_run_url
} }];

const prepared = $json;
const invalidCount = prepared.invalid_rows.length;
return [{ json: {
  batch_id: prepared.batch_id,
  execution_id: prepared.execution_id,
  status: 'NO_VALID_INPUT',
  started_at: prepared.started_at,
  finished_at: $now.toISO(),
  apify_run_id: null,
  dataset_id: null,
  requested_domains: JSON.stringify(prepared.requested_domains),
  valid_domains: 0,
  invalid_domains: invalidCount,
  result_count: invalidCount,
  verified_count: 0,
  review_count: 0,
  no_result_count: invalidCount,
  poll_count: 0,
  error_class: null,
  error_message: 'No valid READY domains were found',
  apify_run_url: null
} }];

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ $('Format failed run log').first().json.error_class + ': ' + $('Format failed run log').first().json.error_message }}
